```{r}
library(randomForest)
```

```{r}
sample_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/conno/Downloads/sample_submission.csv")
test_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/conno/Downloads/test.csv")
train_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/conno/Downloads/train.csv")
```

```{r}
# Inspect the datasets
head(train_data)
head(test_data)

# Check dimensions
dim(train_data)
dim(test_data)

# Check column names
colnames(train_data)

# Check missing values
colSums(is.na(train_data))
colSums(is.na(test_data))
```
```{r}
# Save test IDs
test_ID <- test_data$ID

# Remove ID from training and testing predictors
train_data$ID <- NULL
test_data$ID <- NULL

# Separate target variable
y <- train_data$Y

# Remove target from training data
train_data$Y <- NULL
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
model1 <- randomForest(
  x = train_data,
  y = as.factor(y),
  ntree = 500,
  mtry = 3,
  importance = TRUE
)
```

```


```{r}
predictions <- predict(model1, newdata = test_data, type = "class")

# Convert predictions to numeric 0 and 1
predictions1 <- as.numeric(as.character(predictions))
```

```{r}
prob <- predict(model1, newdata = test_data, type = "prob")[, "1"]

# Try a threshold of 0.3
predictions2 <- ifelse(prob >= 0.3, 1, 0)
```

```{r}
submission <- data.frame(
  ID = test_ID,
  Y = predictions1
)

write.csv(submission,
          file = "submission.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
file.exists("submission.csv")
```
